'''Odalisques''' were people who served in the entourages of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
